info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Payments-v3-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a list of education enrollment payments, enabling users to view payment details associated with various education programs. It serves as a vital resource for financial departments, educational institutions, and administrators seeking to track and manage payment records effectively. Users can retrieve payment information such as status, amount, and student identifiers, which are crucial for accounting and reporting purposes. This API is designed to facilitate seamless integration with existing systems and enhance the financial oversight of educational enrollments.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch payment information related to enrollments. It provides detailed transaction data and status of the payments made for specific enrollments.

requestBody.description: Request body containing payment information for enrollment. Please ensure the data adheres to the expected schema for successful processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the payment enrollment details.
